name: Kodiak Cakes Buttermilk Power Waffles (High Wheat Protein & Fiber Warning)
whyItWorks: Made with 100% whole grain wheat flour, oat flour, and concentrated whey/milk protein isolates. Delivering 4g of coarse whole-grain bran and heavy protein per serving, it frequently causes intense upper GI heaviness, gas, and diarrhea during active IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Flare Warning: Avoid high-protein whole grain waffles during flares. Choose Eggo Homestyle refined flour waffles or Cream of Rice instead.
watchOuts: Dense whole wheat bran and concentrated dairy protein isolate create digestive heaviness and cramps.
